parlays.title: Parlay refinado
parlays.rationale: Selected two independent short-price H2H home favorites. Tartu Welco (1.27) is a league leader with strong form and high edge. Bulls Academy (1.50) has better league standing and faces a winless opponent. Both are highly confident and have short odds, aligning with retrospective insights favoring stable low-odds legs and preferring 2-leg parlays for safety. Omitted legs were either explicitly disallowed (inflated double-chance edge, fragile low total over) or less preferred (BTTS 'yes') based on retrospective analysis.
riskNotes: Both legs have low liquidity and prediction 3 has an uncalibrated high-confidence band warning, suggesting potential model overconfidence.
